nodes.label: desktop memory - the herb-eval arm as the desktop recorded it

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the desktop machine's memory file - the live directory sits on the other machine and is not reachable from here, so this copy is what there is to review. Listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 6. v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py is a fourth retrieval arm, run.py --arm artefact_v1, reproducing the Neo4j herb-eval graph's facet-grounded tag retrieval as a native v3 arm so the cleaned post-thesis artefact graph competes head-to-head with the lucene and vector arms under the same shared generator and the same RAGAS eval at k=50. The pipeline, ported from the deleted v1 TypeScript arm: interpret (two NIM/qwen passes producing a need-description, tags and a hard gate, then per-facet tag scores) to ground (embed prompt tags with the v3 nemotron embedder on NIM, kNN the graph's tag_emb vector index, top-K per prompt tag) to a weighted-overlap scoring Cypher over HAS_TAG edges, top-k, oracle sections excluded, then the shared v3 generator writes the answer. Decisions recorded: the entire arm runs on the v3 model stack via NIM with no local model and no e5; the semantic layer is two nemotron vector families as the user's concept rather than v1-as-built - the tag IS its embedding, t.emb being the bare tag name in one tag_emb index with no pasted-in description context and no per-facet tag vectors, and the chunk description IS an embedding in c.desc_emb - since v1-as-built stuffed descriptions into six per-facet tag vectors, which the user explicitly rejected as 'never wanted that context shit'; herb-eval's tag vocabulary is recorded as CLEAN, verified live 2026-07-01 at 0 eid_ or bare-year tags of 19,716; and the edge shape is ONE HAS_TAG edge per (chunk, tag), verified live at 67,913 edges equalling 67,913 pairs, each carrying the full facet vector as aligned arrays. CANON_AUDIT.md 6.4 verdict: AGENT-ORIGIN and internally incoherent - the file states both that context_ids are real and that context_ids is empty, and both that the v1 full-text fallback is DELETED and that a gated full-text fallback is kept, two flat self-contradictions about the arm that produces every reported number
